sloka: वीर्योत्सेकेन दुष्टात्मा वरदानाच्च मोहितः ।जगाम सुमहाकाय स्समुद्रं सरितां पतिम् ॥४-११-८॥।।
transliteration: vīryotsekena duṣṭātmā varadānācca mohitaḥ ।jagāma sumahākāya ssamudraṁ saritāṁ patim ॥4-11-8॥।।

translations.english: 'Wicked Dundubhi of huge body was proud of his valour and deluded by virtue of the boons, went to the ocean, the lord of rivers.
